Blue Collar Mini $159 Add to Cart The Blue Collar overdrive is the second pedal design from Menatone.  It debuted in 1997 at a request for a Red Snapper with more gain and compression.  The Blue Collar produces a fat, midrangey tone that loves single coils.  The gain ranges from just above clean to a beautiful, full, smooth grind with great harmonics and sustain.  While smooth, lots of complexity and clairity remains.   This new for 2025 Blue Collar mini adds the presence control,  each one is made by hand, one at a time in the USA Dimensions are 1.5" x 3.66" Power supply must be used,  no battery for the mini.
